title: Order relative to authorizing the joint committee on Transportation to make an investigation and study of certain current Senate documents relative to transportation matters.

abstracts.abstract: Senate, July 31, 2026 -- The committee on Transportation, to whom was referred the petitions (accompanied by bill, Senate, No. 2363) of John J. Cronin for legislation to establish a separate fund to be known as the InterCity Regional Passenger Rail Fund; (accompanied by bill, Senate, No. 2372) of Sal N. DiDomenico for legislation relative to mobile carrying devices; (accompanied by bill, Senate, No. 2379) of William J. Driscoll, Jr. for legislation relative to fully autonomous vehicle and human drivers; (accompanied by bill, Senate, No. 2393) of Paul R. Feeney for legislation relative to the safety and standards of autonomous vehicles; (accompanied by bill, Senate, No. 2429) of Patrick M. O'Connor for legislation to ensure benefits through enhanced Selective Service registration; and (accompanied by bill, Senate, No. 2905) (subject to Joint Rule 12) of Julian Cyr for legislation to provide for mobile driver’s licenses in the commonwealth, report the accompanying Order  (Senate, No. 3245).
